messages:
support-sw: Hey team — escalation from Acme Analytics. They see ~200-400ms extra tail latency and a bunch of 502/504s starting this morning. They say their app is pinned to eu-west-1 but our logs show requests bouncing to us-west and back. Customer impact: pages/timeouts and unexpected egress billing.

ajay: Oof. Do we have a sample request id or SDK logs? Which SDK version?

support-sw: They sent an SDK trace and a couple request ids: req_01F7X9... and req_01F7Y2... SDK: python-sdk v1.8.2. Excerpt from their client log (redacted):

support-sw: ```
[2026-02-27T09:12:01Z] send attempt 1 -> region=eu-west-1 endpoint=https://api.eu-west-1.redwood.ai latency=95ms
[2026-02-27T09:12:01Z] timeout waiting for first-byte 400ms
[2026-02-27T09:12:01Z] hedged attempt 2 -> region=us-west-2 endpoint=https://api.us-west-2.redwood.ai latency=32ms
[2026-02-27T09:12:01Z] response 200 via us-west-2
[2026-02-27T09:12:01Z] followup attempt -> region=eu-west-1 endpoint=https://api.eu-west-1.redwood.ai response 502
```

support-sw: They report this pattern repeats — first request goes to eu, hits a slow priming op (cold node) > client hedges to us-west, then followup from eu returns later (sometimes error). The SDK keeps doing cross-region hedging which inflates latency and cross-region egress.

elaine: That log is key — hedged attempts are enabled by default in 1.8.x iirc. We did a change last quarter to experiment with hedging across zones to reduce P99. Looks like the client's region affinity isn't being respected when hedging kicks in.

chris: Repro steps? Can we trigger locally with the python-sdk and a mock slow response in eu?

support-sw: Customer provided a small repro snippet:

support-sw: ```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(region='eu-west-1', hedged_requests=True, hedged_timeout_ms=400)
resp = client.generate("hello world")
print(resp)
```

support-sw: They say hedged_timeout_ms is default 400ms. If we set hedged_requests=False they no longer cross regions but tail latency is worse. If we raise hedged_timeout_ms to 800ms, hedging rarely triggers and cross-region traffic drops.

ajay: Looks like two problems: 1) hedging can choose a different region endpoint and 2) subsequent/eager in-flight retry from original region may still arrive causing duplicate work and sporadic 502s when primed nodes are in an odd state. We should stop hedged attempts from changing region — they should only pick alternate node within same region until capacity is exhausted.

ops-sre: I pulled the routing logs for the request ids. On our side: first connection from client to eu-west-1 proxied to node eu-prim-08 which was under memory pressure (OOM killer had recently restarted the worker). Response stalled -> client triggered hedged attempt -> new connection landed on us-west-2. When eu node recovered it returned a 502 due to incomplete stream reassembly. We could have returned 409 or cancel in-flight but current runtime will complete both and return whichever finishes first.

chris: Actionable items:
- short-term: ask customer to set hedged_requests=False or increase hedged_timeout_ms to 800 for now (support -> customer).
- medium: SDK patch to restrict hedged attempts to same-region endpoints and add explicit region-affinity header `X-Client-Region` so routing can pin requests.
- long-term: runtime change to cancel sibling in-flight requests when a hedged winner is identified, and avoid returning late 5xx if another attempt already succeeded.

deploy-bot: New issue created: INF-6221 "sdk: hedged requests must honor region affinity" assigned to eng-runtime.

elaine: Also add a telemetry counter for cross-region hedged attempts per tenant + a billing guard to block cross-region egress spikes (notify billing ops).

support-sw: I told Acme to flip hedged_requests off and we'll monitor. They confirmed initial drop in cross-region egress; still want low p99, so we'll push the SDK fix.

ajay: I'll pair with eng-runtime on the SDK change. For the SDK patch, propose default hedged_timeout_ms->800 and add option `hedge_same_region_only: true` (default true). We'll document the behavior change in the release notes and ship a minor version.

ops-sre: Putting a temporary routing rule: if request includes `X-Client-Region` and tenant pins region, reject attempts from other regions with 421 Misdirected Request so SDK will not accept cross-region success. Will test on staging.

support-sw: Thanks all — sending customer a timeline. Will reopen thread with any new req ids. :thumbsup:
